discription: A metallic bell-like sound generated by combining several harmonically unrelated sine waves with a quick attack and a long, decaying envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1;var sig, env;env = EnvGen.ar(Env.perc(0.001, 1.5, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2);sig = SinOsc.ar(freq) * 0.6;sig = sig + SinOsc.ar(freq * 1.4) * 0.3;sig = sig + SinOsc.ar(freq * 2.1) * 0.2;sig = sig + SinOsc.ar(freq * 2.7) * 0.1;sig = sig * amp * env;Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
